sections.text:
The spring washers, split pins and tap washers of any screwed joint opened for 
maintenance purposes must be replaced.

The same applies to all seals and gaskets exposed during external metal parts 
should be lubricated with Tecty1 506 at intervals of 2 to 3 years.

All open breaker parts should be covered to protect them against the ingress of 
dirt while assembly is in progress. Any switching dust which has settled in the 
breaker and on the built-in parts during operation should be removed immediately 
the breaker is opened and any subassemblies have been removed. When this dust is 
exposed to the air for some time it will absorb moisture and can then only be 
removed with difficulty.
Wipe off the dust with a rag or use a vacuum cleaner.
Do not disturb the dust unnecessarily
Throw the dust and the rag into a refuse bin as soon as the job is finished.

Do not disturb the dust unnecessarily
Throw the dust and the rag into a refuse bin as soon as the job is finished.

Check SF6 pressure and, if the values do not tally, test the pressure gauges 
 and check the breaker for leaks.
Read and record the counter reading (where applicable).
Examine paint finish and touch up damaged sections.
Draw off the SF6

Open one interrupter unit of each breaker pole, check the contacts and replace 
 them if they show signs of severe are erosion If contact replacement proves to 
 be necessary, see mpis docs CB-148-r0
Replace filters.

Auxiliary switches sparingly oil the contacts and bearings, examine and grease 
 the coupling linkage.
Fill in the SF6
Check the oil level.
Examine all pipe joints for correct sealing.
Drain off the oil and clean both the oil tank and the intake filter.
Fill in the oil.
Measure the provisional nitrogen pressure on the oil side.

Raise the oil pressure in the storage sy1inder to the nominal level. Measure 
 the current input to the motor at this pressure
Test operations.
Measure the minimum operating pressure.
Measure the minimum operating voltage of the opening and closing magnet.
Check the operating pressure of the safety valve.

Test the density and pressure switches:
 - Switch B4 (SF6 : General lockout, loss of SF6)
 - Switch B3 (oil pressure : Auto-re-closure lockout, Motor control)
 - Switch B2 (oil pressure : General lockout, minimum pressure lockout ON)
 - Switch B1 (loss of nitrogen)
Connect up a test gauge and test the SF6 pressure gauge
Connect up a test gauge and test the hydraulic pressure gauge
Check the current consumption of the anti-condensation heaters
Check the enforced triple-pole operation feature and the anti-pumping feature
Check all fully assembled breakers for leaks
Tighten all terminals.

sections_ar.text: يجب استبدال الورد النابضية (spring washers) والمسامير المشقوقة (split pins) وورد الصنبور (tap washers) الخاصة بأي وصلة مسمارية تُفتح لأغراض الصيانة.
ينطبق الأمر نفسه على جميع الحشوات (seals) والجوانات (gaskets) المكشوفة أثناء الصيانة، ويجب تشحيم الأجزاء المعدنية الخارجية بمادة Tectyl 506 على فترات من سنتين إلى ثلاث سنوات.

يجب تغطية جميع أجزاء القاطع المفتوحة لحمايتها من دخول الأتربة أثناء التركيب. وأي غبار ناتج عن عمليات الفصل والوصل ترسّب في القاطع وعلى الأجزاء المركّبة به أثناء التشغيل يجب إزالته فور فتح القاطع وإزالة أي وحدات فرعية. فعندما يتعرض هذا الغبار للهواء لبعض الوقت فإنه يمتص الرطوبة ويصعب بعد ذلك إزالته.

افتح وحدة قطع (interrupter) واحدة من كل قطب في القاطع، وافحص الملامسات واستبدلها إذا ظهرت عليها علامات تآكل شديد بسبب القوس الكهربائي. وإذا ثبتت ضرورة استبدال الملامسات، فراجع مستندات MPIS رقم CB-148-r0

 - المفتاح B3 (ضغط الزيت: قفل إعادة الإغلاق التلقائي، التحكم في المحرك)
 - المفتاح B2 (ضغط الزيت: قفل عام، قفل الحد الأدنى للضغط في وضع التشغيل ON)
 - المفتاح B1 (فقدان النيتروجين)
